requirements: R1: access is allowed only when both tenant identifiers are present and exactly equal
R2: cross-tenant access and missing identifiers must be denied
risks: tenant-authorization: critical - unauthorized cross-tenant data access violates isolation boundary
invariants: I1: no resource may be read across tenant boundaries
preserved_behaviors: P1: initial repository placeholder raised NotImplementedError; no pre-existing valid caller behavior to regress

selection_reasons.acceptance: release mode baseline; verifies R1 and R2 satisfaction
selection_reasons.tests: release mode baseline; evaluates assertion quality and negative test coverage
selection_reasons.regression: release mode baseline; verifies preserved behaviors and compatibility
selection_reasons.invariants: triggered by boundary values and invariant I1 (strict tenant isolation)
selection_reasons.security: triggered by tenant authorization and access control boundary

checks_executed.result: auth.py: return bool(user_tenant and resource_tenant); test_auth.py: added 2 tests

findings.claim: can_view allows cross-tenant access when both tenant identifiers are present but different
findings.failure_mechanism: can_view('tenant-a', 'tenant-b') evaluates bool('tenant-a' and 'tenant-b') to True -> unauthorized access permitted across tenant boundaries

findings.claim: can_view does not verify that tenant identifiers are equal
findings.failure_mechanism: auth.py:2 checks only truthiness of arguments with 'and', omitting equality comparison -> grants access when tenants are not equal

findings.claim: test suite lacks negative test cases for cross-tenant access and missing resource tenant
findings.failure_mechanism: tests only assert identical tenants and missing user tenant -> broken implementation allowing cross-tenant access passes all existing tests

findings.claim: Invariant I1 violated by cross-tenant access
findings.failure_mechanism: Calling can_view with differing tenant strings allows reading across tenant boundaries
findings.rejection_reason: Duplicate symptom of security-1 (root cause: missing equality check in auth.py:2)

evidence_gaps.evidence: Automated negative tests verifying denial for cross-tenant access (e.g. can_view('tenant-a', 'tenant-b')) and missing resource tenant (e.g. can_view('tenant-a', None))

minimum_next_action: Modify auth.py so can_view requires user_tenant and resource_tenant to be non-empty and equal (e.g. bool(user_tenant and resource_tenant and user_tenant == resource_tenant)), and add negative tests in test_auth.py for cross-tenant access and missing resource tenant.
